ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - PowerTool Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the tool PowerTool which has the ability to kill a process, delete its process file, unload drivers, and delete the driver files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\PowerTool\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\PowerTool64\\\.exe$")) OR process_original_file_name = "PowerTool\.exe")
